disciplines.title: Three sports. One crew.
disciplines.text: Group sessions are added to the schedule as they're planned. Show up for one sport or all three.

items.title: Swim
items.text: Build comfort and speed in the water, whether it's laps in the pool or an open-water outing.

items.title: Bike
items.text: Group rides around the valley. Learn to ride in a pack and see roads you wouldn't find alone.

items.title: Run
items.text: Easy miles, long runs and a few harder days, with people to keep you honest.

about.title: Boise's training crew
paragraphs: Boise is called the City of Trees, and the river, the Greenbelt and the foothills put good swim, bike and run training right at our doorstep.
City of Trees Triathlon Club is for people who'd rather do that training together: beginners and veterans, sprint racers and Ironman hopefuls. Come try a session and see if it's a fit.

photo.alt: A runner mid-stride during a race

steps.title: Join the team
steps.text: Fill out the quick form and join our Strava club so you see every session.

steps.title: Pick a session
steps.text: Check the schedule for the next ride, run, or swim and where it starts.

steps.title: Show up
steps.text: Meet the group, move at your own pace, and make it a habit.

cta.headline: Come try a session.
cta.text: Pick a ride or run from the schedule and show up. Introduce yourself and we'll take it from there.

faq.q: Do I need to be an experienced triathlete?
faq.a: No. Beginners are welcome. Come to a session, meet people, and go at your own pace.
Every session on the schedule lists its start location, with a directions link.
Water, and the gear for the sport: a helmet and a bike in good working order for rides, and comfortable running shoes for runs.

faq.q: How do I stay in the loop?
faq.a: Join the club on Strava and check the schedule page, which is updated whenever new sessions are added.

notes: Arrive a few minutes early so we can start on time.
